DAY 3 ・ 10/18 Mon

Hakone: Free Pass + six kinds of transport

🏨 Hakone Hotel (to be confirmed)
  1. 07:40
    Head out
    🚆Bakuro-yokoyama → Toei Shinjuku Line direct to Shinjuku (approx. 20 min)
    💡Breakfast: Tokyo Hotel; recommend leaving large luggage at Tokyo Hotel
  2. 08:30
    Shinjuku → Hakone-Yumoto
    🚆① Romancecar
    💡Limited express ticket bought separately, reserve ahead

    Arrive at Hakone-Yumoto, leave luggage at Hakone Hotel
    🚶3-minute walk
    💡Luggage can be dropped off before check-in
  4. 10:20
    Hakone-Yumoto → Gora
    🚆② Tozan Railway
  5. 11:05
    LunchTamura Ginkatsu-tei main store
    🚆2-min walk from Gora Station
    💡No reservations, get a numbered ticket on site; if the main store line is too long, go to the old store across the street, or eat at Owakudani instead
  6. 12:10
    Gora → Sounzan
    🚆③ Tozan Cable Car
  7. 12:30
    Sounzan → Owakudani (eat black eggs, kuro-tamago)
    🚆④ Ropeway
    💡Ropeway runs until 17:00
  8. 13:30
    Owakudani → Togendai → cruise Lake Ashi → Moto-Hakone port
    🚆④ Ropeway → ⑤ Pirate Ship
  9. 15:00
    Hakone Shrine
    🚶Walk
    💡If the torii line is too long, take photos from the side
  10. 16:15
    Moto-Hakone → Hakone-Yumoto
    🚆⑥ Tozan Bus (covered by Free Pass)
  11. 17:00
    Check in at Hakone Hotel
    💡Dinner TBD (see alternatives in “Meal overview”)

  1. 07:00
